story: Player refuses identity details, questions the deposit, refuses the gift-card code, hangs up and checks the Bluebonnet portal (which says Bluebonnet never charges for equipment).

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is Marcus with Bluebonnet Labs Onboarding, calling about your new-hire setup.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: New-hire setup? I haven't even interviewed yet. What is this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Welcome to the Bluebonnet family! For the Junior Data Analyst role we ship equipment early. First I just need to confirm your date of birth and home address.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: I'm not giving that out on a call. Why would onboarding need that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Totally get it, Bluebonnet loves security-minded people! Here's the thing: your laptop kit needs a $350 refundable equipment deposit, and the shipping slot releases at 5 PM today.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Why would a company charge me for equipment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It comes right back in your first paycheck! Fastest way is a gift card. Got one handy? Read me the code on the back and you're all set, family!

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: No. I don't share gift card codes. I'll check with Bluebonnet myself.
